name: Highway
rule: A paved highway. The fastest way between towns, and the most exposed.

name: Street
rule: A city or town street. It reaches the places along it and carries noise.

name: Track
rule: A dirt track, fire road, or overgrown lane. Slower going, but quiet.

name: Rail line
rule: A railway line. The rails still run somewhere, and the line is often the only clear way through.
